use_case_summary: ConverseFlux wants a simple hosted API to generate per-call summaries, action items, and searchable embeddings for a small to mid-size sales org. Primary requirement: robust PII handling and configurable retention. Start self-serve; may expand to Dedicated if volume or compliance needs justify it.
technical_requirements: Hosted API with: configurable retention window (default 7d, configurable to 0), field-level redaction API, ability to opt-out of transcript persistence, KMS support for embeddings at rest, SOC2 attestation, EU routing option for EU customers, latency expectation: summary job <= 2s for 30s audio (post-processing acceptable), throughput initial: ~20 daily summaries ramping to 500/day over 6 months.
decision_criteria: 1) Clear PII retention & redaction controls (MUST). 2) Cost per summary/minute aligns with SMB budget. 3) Easy self-serve onboarding + transparent perf benchmarks. 4) Optional EU routing / data residency. 5) Contractual purge capability and response SLAs for data subject requests.
